one-ten.title: youn, de, twa…
one-ten.bodyMarkdown:
Start with the first ten numbers:

1 **youn** · 2 **de** · 3 **twa** · 4 **kat** · 5 **senk**

6 **sis** · 7 **sèt** · 8 **wit** · 9 **nèf** · 10 **dis**

Hear them in small groups and reuse them with words you already know.

eleven-twenty.title: onz through ven
eleven-twenty.bodyMarkdown:
Continue from eleven to twenty:

11 **onz** · 12 **douz** · 13 **trèz** · 14 **katòz** · 15 **kenz**

16 **sèz** · 17 **disèt** · 18 **dizwit** · 19 **diznèf** · 20 **ven**

Focus on recognizing and saying the numbers naturally; you are not doing arithmetic.

number-plus-noun.title: number + noun
number-plus-noun.bodyMarkdown:
Numbers can go directly before a noun:

- **de liv** — two books
- **twa valiz** — three bags
- **senk kaye** — five notebooks

This connects the numbers to useful everyday quantities.
